description: This file defines the CustomerDAO interface for data access operations related to Customer entities within the sales management system. It extends a generic DAO and declares methods for retrieving customers by name, nickname, store, and criteria.

classes.name: CustomerDAO
classes.description: Interface for customer data access operations, extending generic DAO functionality with specific methods for customer retrieval based on various parameters.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customer objects matching the provided name.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of customers associated with the specified store.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Fetches a Customer using their nickname.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of customers based on store and criteria.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by nickname within a specific store ID.
